uncertainObservations: The image is extremely dark overall; nearly all detail required brightness/contrast boosting to read, so counts and contents carry residual risk.

Cup count is the main uncertainty. I can see 7 cups (4 upper, 3 lower). The horizontal spacing of the lower row is irregular: the gap between the far-left (key) niche and the center (cloth) niche is roughly double the gap between the center and right niches, which is wide enough for one more niche to sit entirely behind the figure's robe. I could not confirm or rule out an 8th occluded cup; nothing in the visible wall edges to either side of the robe shows a niche frame.
The content of the lower-right cup reads as an upright oval with a bright rim — most consistent with a mirror or a large oval gem, but I cannot resolve which.
I cannot tell whether the figure is placing the cloth onto the lower-center cup or lifting it off.
Whether the raised hand actually touches the serpent cup's base is unclear; the fingertips appear to stop just short of the niche ledge.
The figure's sex, age and face are not determinable — the figure is seen entirely from behind.
The exact direction of the off-frame light is inferred from shadow and rim-light only; no light source is visible in frame.
